_comment: Verify SPRITE_HOT_POINTS fix: units must sit centred on their tile anchor, not low-left. Derived from peek_units.json with the documented-broken n-cycle tail removed.

COORD RULE (CORRECTED 2026-07-25 -- the old blanket 'send cx*1.25' here was wrong). GEOMETRY: the engine blits its 1024x768 surface UNSCALED into the client's top-left, so capture coords ARE engine coords, 1:1 (measured content bbox 0,0-1021,759). The SEND scale is NOT derived from that geometry -- it is empirical and PER-SURFACE: message = x0.80, alertbox = x1.25. x1.25 on the MESSAGE surface is process-lethal (0xC0000005, 2/2 runs). Buttons/lists prefer the injection hook (press:/select:), which needs no coords at all. Full element map: ../ui_map.json
page down: trough below thumb, capture (797,450) -> send (996,562). VERIFIED. NOTE: this is COSMETIC - the select-by-index step below does not need the row visible.
OK == ScenarioWindow.LoadButton (str_ldl_SCEN_LOAD); drills into the MoM pack
FRONTIER E1: confirm the pack. select inner row 0 then OK. PREDICTION: panel closes -> back at new_game with scenario set.
FRONTIER E2: LAUNCH. PREDICTION: long load then the map screen. SLIC only enters scope here (L5).

COORD RULE SUPERSEDED 2026-07-26: the per-surface send scales (message x0.80, alertbox x1.25) were DPI artifacts, not engine behaviour -- uiwalk used to call SetProcessDPIAware() while ctp2.exe has no DPI manifest, so on a 125% primary our rects were physical (1280x960) and the game's were logical (1024x768), a ratio of exactly 1.25. uiwalk no longer declares awareness, so send == capture, 1:1, on EVERY surface.

NO DISMISS CLICK. Measured 2026-07-26: a posted click here is process-lethal (0xC0000005), reproducibly, ~5 runs. Falsified as causes: (a) my rebuilt GU091/092/093 sprites -- a control run with base art restored still AV'd; (b) the coordinate, corrected from (395,42) to (494,52) under the new 1:1 rule -- still AV'd. The AV is the click ITSELF. It is also unnecessary: with the click replaced by a plain wait, the run completes all 14 shots and scores 4/4 goldens at 1.000, reaching a settled map frame. If a dismiss is ever genuinely needed, use the injection hook (press:/select:), which needs no coordinates and does not post mouse input.
Centre the view on the active unit so its tile is mid-screen and measurable.
